whyItIsWrong: The researcher described one study in the shape every medical researcher describes one: who, what is given, against what, which endpoint, which design, which data, where the work stands. The facts were kept, but under keys the model made up for the occasion (project.af_cohort.exposure_comparator, project.primary_outcome, project.study_design ... over the ten studies of the replay), so the memory page could list them and could not say what the project was; the specialty and the stage were not kept at all. Across ten studies in different fields, 122 of 240 stated slots came back under a key the card could read, and none of the thirty specialties.
expected: Each thing the researcher stated is a project_fact under the card's own key (project.field, population, intervention, comparator, outcome, design, data_source, stage), and the specialty is a name from the frontier feed's list of twenty-one.
